report_sentences: On Tuesday, the Lakeside ferry was delayed for 20 minutes.
A crew shut the north gate for a routine ramp inspection.
Staff gave waiting passengers an update while the crew finished the inspection.
Riders at the terminal waited under the covered walkway.
After a check with the harbor office, the operator said thick fog caused the delay.
Passengers boarded through the south gate at 8:40 a.m.
summary.reference: Thick fog delayed the Lakeside ferry for 20 minutes. Passengers boarded at the south gate at 8:40 a.m., and no sailings were canceled.

After a check with the harbor office, the operator said thick fog caused the delay. Passengers boarded through the south gate at 8:40 a.m. No sailings were canceled.
